Behavior: domains.assistants.features.creation.behaviors.assistant_creation
  Conditions:
    assistant: draft
  Trigger:
    trigger: The Member provides valid configuration and requests creation.
  Outcome:
    outcome: The Assistant is created for the Member's organization and can respond to a message.
  Failures:
    rejected: No partial Assistant remains and the Member receives an actionable explanation.
  Signals produced:
    assistant_created
  Signals consumed:
    none
  Obligation paths:
    domains.assistants.features.creation.behaviors.assistant_creation.completion
    domains.assistants.features.creation.behaviors.assistant_creation.conditions
    domains.assistants.features.creation.behaviors.assistant_creation.failures.rejected
    domains.assistants.features.creation.behaviors.assistant_creation.outcome
    domains.assistants.features.creation.behaviors.assistant_creation.trigger
  Related to:
    none
  Use cases:
    domains.assistants.features.creation.use_cases.create_from_scratch
